pages.title: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Shows a personalized briefing, live counter cards for pending actions (screening, shortlist, scheduling, interviews, offers, failed calls), today’s interview agenda with join links and quick actions, and a shortlist queue with scores and links to candidate profiles.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page to get a quick snapshot of what hiring tasks need your attention today and to jump directly to interviews or candidates that require action.

elements.label: Join
elements.does: Opens the interview’s meeting link in a new tab so you can join the scheduled interview.

elements.label: View all
elements.does: Navigates to the full list of candidates that need action (candidates tab on the dashboard).

elements.label: · passed final round
elements.does: Appears as a link without a defined click handler; likely meant to show candidates who passed the final round, but no action is confirmed.
Link with placeholder text and no handler; specific action unknown.
Link with minimal text and no handler; specific function unknown.

pages.title: Analytics
pages.purpose: Shows hiring pipeline metrics including total candidates, AI call stats, screening pass rate, overall conversion, a visual hiring funnel, conversion rates, screening score distribution, and AI call performance details.
pages.whenToUse: Visit this page to review overall recruiting performance, see how candidates move through stages, and evaluate AI call effectiveness.

pages.title: Calls
pages.purpose: The page shows a dashboard of voice calls: summary stats (today's calls, completed, avg duration, completion rate, queued auto‑calls), live in‑progress calls, upcoming reminder/result calls, and a list of recent completed calls. Tabs let you switch between an overview, today’s calls, or all calls.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page to monitor current calls, see upcoming automatic reminder or result calls, and review call activity for today or the whole history.

elements.label: call with m s elapsed
elements.selector: a >> text=call with m s elapsed
fallbacks: a >> text=call with m s elapsed
elements.does: Opens the detailed view for that specific call (URL `/dashboard/calls/<call‑id>`), where the user can see full call information and related candidate data.

pages.title: Call Detail
pages.purpose: Shows detailed information for a specific call, including its type, candidate name, status badge, duration, timestamp, audio recording (if available), transcript, AI‑generated summary, and any data extracted from the conversation.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page when you need to review the full details of a particular call, listen to the recording, read the transcript, see the AI summary, or view extracted data.

pages.title: Candidates
pages.purpose: Displays a list of candidates in your pipeline, lets you filter by job, stage, or search term, and provides quick access to add a new candidate.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page to view, search, and manage candidates, or to start adding a new candidate.

elements.label: Add Candidate
elements.does: Opens the "Add Candidate" form at /dashboard/candidates/new.

elements.label: form-171
elements.does: Submits the search term entered in the input as the query parameter q, reloading the page with filtered candidates.

elements.label: Search name, email, phone...
elements.does: Collects the text the user types to search candidates by name, email or phone; the value is sent as the q parameter when the form is submitted.

elements.label: Clear
elements.does: Removes the current search query (q parameter) and reloads the page showing all candidates.

elements.label: All Jobs
elements.does: Clears any job filter, showing candidates from every job.

elements.label: Add Candidate
elements.does: Opens the "Add Candidate" form at /dashboard/candidates/new.

pages.title: Candidate Detail
pages.purpose: Displays a single candidate’s profile including name, role, score, qualification status, stage badge, and a timeline of past activity, plus action buttons for calls, shortlisting, scheduling, and interview management.
pages.whenToUse: Open this page when you need to view or update a specific candidate’s information, track their progress through hiring stages, or manage interview actions.

elements.label: Join Meet
elements.does: Opens the video‑meeting (e.g., Google Meet) for the candidate’s scheduled interview.

pages.title: Add Candidate
pages.purpose: Shows a form for entering a new candidate’s details (full name, phone, optional email, and optional job) and saving them to the pipeline.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page when you want to add a new candidate to the hiring pipeline.

elements.id: Full Name * Phone Number * Email Job Select a job (optional) Add Candidate
elements.label: Full Name * Phone Number * Email Job Select a job (optional) Add Candidate
elements.selector: form >> text=Full Name * Phone Number * Email Job Select a job (optional) Add Candidate
fallbacks: form >> text=Full Name * Phone Number * Email Job Select a job (optional) Add Candidate
elements.does: Wraps all input fields and the submit button; when submitted it triggers the server‑side createCandidate action.

elements.label: name
elements.does: Collects the candidate’s full name; the value is sent as the “name” field when the form is submitted.
Collects the candidate’s phone number (required); the value is sent as the “phone” field when the form is submitted.

elements.label: email
elements.does: Collects the candidate’s email address (optional); the value is sent as the “email” field when the form is submitted.

elements.label: Add Candidate
elements.does: Submits the form, creates a new candidate record in the database, and redirects to the candidates list page.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.does: Navigates back to the candidates list page without saving any entered information.

pages.title: Helpdesk
pages.purpose: Displays a list of employee support tickets, grouped into Open and Resolved sections, each showing the employee name, ticket bucket, status, query preview, and creation date.
pages.whenToUse: Visit this page when you need to see current helpdesk tickets or check their status.

pages.title: Interviews
pages.purpose: Displays a list of interviews grouped by time (Today, This Week, Later, Action‑needed, Past) and lets you filter them by job. Each interview row shows the candidate, job, interviewer, scheduled time, and status‑specific actions.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page when you need to view upcoming interviews, take required actions (send reminders, submit feedback, communicate results), or review past interview history.

elements.label: All Jobs
elements.does: Clears any job filter and shows interviews for all open jobs.

elements.label: a-149
elements.does: Filters the interview list to only show interviews for the specific job represented by this link (the job title is shown on the link).

elements.label: a-170
elements.does: Filters the interview list to only show interviews for the specific job represented by this link.

elements.label: a-285
elements.does: Filters the interview list to only show interviews for the specific job represented by this link.

elements.label: Join
elements.does: Opens the interview’s meeting URL in a new browser tab so you can join the scheduled video call.

pages.title: Jobs
pages.purpose: Displays all job postings, grouped into Open Positions and Paused/Closed. Each job row shows title, status, department, location, work model, role type, salary range, a mini pipeline of candidate counts per stage, total candidates, and links to the job’s detail page. Provides a “Create Job” button to add a new posting, and an empty state when no jobs exist.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page to review current job openings, see how many candidates are in each hiring stage, access a specific job’s details, or create a new job posting.

elements.label: Create Job
elements.does: Navigates to the new‑job form (/dashboard/jobs/new) so you can create a new job posting.

elements.label: Create Job
elements.does: Navigates to the new‑job form (/dashboard/jobs/new) so you can create a new job posting.

pages.title: Job Detail
pages.purpose: Displays a single job’s information—including title, department, location, role type, salary range, required skills, interview rounds, total candidates, and default interviewer—plus a pipeline of candidates that can be filtered by stage.
pages.whenToUse: Visit this page to review a job’s details, change its default interviewer, or browse and manage its candidates by stage.

elements.label: All
elements.does: Navigates to the same job page without a stage query, showing all candidates for the job.

pages.title: Create Job
pages.purpose: A form for adding a new open position, letting you specify the title, department, location, work model, role type, required skills, salary range, interview defaults and a full job description.
pages.whenToUse: Use this page whenever you need to publish a new job opening in the system.

elements.id: Job Title * Department Location Work Model Select Office Hybrid Remote Role
elements.label: Job Title * Department Location Work Model Select Office Hybrid Remote Role
elements.selector: form >> text=Job Title * Department Location Work Model Select Office Hybrid Remote Role
fallbacks: form >> text=Job Title * Department Location Work Model Select Office Hybrid Remote Role
elements.does: Contains all input fields and controls for defining a new job posting.

elements.label: Senior Software Engineer
elements.does: Text input where you type the job title (e.g., Senior Software Engineer).

elements.label: Engineering
elements.does: Text input for the department name of the role.

elements.label: Mumbai
elements.does: Text input for the location where the job will be based.

elements.label: React, Node.js
elements.does: Text input for required skills, entered as a comma‑separated list.

elements.label: salary_min
elements.does: Numeric input for the minimum salary (LPA) the role offers.

elements.label: salary_max
elements.does: Numeric input for the maximum salary (LPA) the role offers.

elements.label: default_duration
elements.does: Numeric input for the default interview duration in minutes.

elements.label: total_rounds
elements.does: Numeric input for how many interview rounds the hiring process will have.

elements.label: Create Job
elements.does: Submits the form and creates the new job record, then redirects to the jobs list.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.does: Cancels the creation and returns to the jobs list without saving.

pages.title: Settings
pages.purpose: Shows the user’s profile details (name, email, role), HR sender status, list of interviewers, and the status of external integrations like Twilio, Deepgram, Claude, Google Calendar, Gmail API, and Supabase, plus success banners for recent connections.
pages.whenToUse: Visit this page whenever you need to view or update your account information, check integration connections, or manage your recruiting team’s interviewers.
